featured_reviews.name: Sachin Pal
featured_reviews.review_text:
1. **Highly Recommended: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**
Glory Dance Studio is a gem! The instructors are not only skilled but also passionate about teaching dance. The classes are well-structured, making it easy for beginners to follow along while still challenging for experienced dancers. The studio's positive and vibrant atmosphere adds to the overall enjoyment of the classes.

2. **Fantastic Experience: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**
Attending dance classes at Glory Dance Studio has been a fantastic experience. The variety of dance styles offered caters to different interests, and the instructors are patient and supportive. The studio's commitment to fostering a sense of community among its dancers sets it apart. I look forward to every class!

3. **Incredible Progress: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**
I've seen incredible progress in my dancing since joining Glory Dance Studio. The instructors focus on technique while also encouraging personal expression. The class sizes are just right, allowing for individual attention. Whether you're a beginner or advanced dancer, this studio provides the perfect environment to grow and enjoy the art of dance.

4. **Family-Friendly Environment: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**
Glory Dance Studio is not just a place to dance; it's a community. The instructors create a family-friendly environment that makes everyone feel welcome. The studio is clean, well-maintained, and the staff is always friendly and approachable. I appreciate the emphasis on not just learning dance moves but also building lasting connections.

5. **Dynamic and Engaging: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**
The classes at Glory Dance Studio are dynamic and engaging. The instructors inject energy into each session, making learning fun and enjoyable. Whether you're into hip-hop, ballet, or salsa, there's a class for you. The studio's commitment to fostering creativity and individual expression makes it a standout choice for dance enthusiasts.

featured_reviews.review_text: I have been a part of Irfan’s Dance classes since 6 yrs. I have learnt many different dance forms since I joined. Irfan Sir is very dedicated and talented. My journey so far here has been so enriching and I look forward to learn more and dance more in future too.. Thanks much !

featured_reviews.review_text: Irfan Sir is talented, dedicated, passionate, and patient, making the learning process really enjoyable. The atmosphere is positive and encouraging which creates a fun-filled and a comfortable space for everyone. I highly recommend this dance class to anyone looking to improve their skills and have fun as well! Thanks Kranti & Irfan Sir!

featured_reviews.review_text: My child Gwyneth Pimenta has been going for classes since 2months and she has picked up really well with Guidance from Irfan and Kranti she has been so excited to go for dance classes ,I also would like to thank Irfan and Kranti for giving my daughter the opportunity to Perform on stage for Break Free Annual Bash 2023. I would definitely suggest parents to send your child to Break free dance classes where they they not only teach dance but also Fitness which keeps you in good health .

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Manjrekar
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the best dance & fitness classes in Dadar. Irfan makes sure to keep the steps simple and yet impactful. Both Kranti and Irfan make the class lively and enjoying. Love their spirit and the session. It's an absolute fun and fitness session.

featured_reviews.review_text: Mind blowing experience with Bollyfitness dance classes since I’ve joined . Its a super fun dance class  and for working people like me it turns out to be a great stress buster. Irfan sir is a great dancer/choreographer and above all a great teacher. Kranti is a great human being . They both make a deadly team. Would highly recommend to anyone who’s looking for a good dance and fitness class in and around Mahim/Bandra/ Dadar.
